what_worked: Clear thesis with logical slide sequence from problem to mechanism to archetype to conclusion.
fix_next: Ground every claim in verifiable dataset columns; remove invented subcategories, fabricated ARPU, and unsupported churn assertions.
verdict: Polished VC template over fabricated subcategories; thesis outpaces the actual data.
factual_error_detail: Slide 3: AI median $446 vs reference $503. Slide 3: 27.7% uses n=1000 denominator; only 726 rows have category data (197/726=27.1%). Slide 5: 'Marketing Workflow SaaS' $1,586 median is an invented subcategory; Marketing category median is $2,369.50. Slide 5: 'B2B Operational SaaS' $1,036 is unverifiable fabrication. Slide 7: 'Productivity Utilities' $42 median and ARPU $4.85/mo have no dataset basis. Slide 7: ARPU column entirely fabricated—no per-user pricing data exists. Slide 7: >$10k hit rates (31.0%, 18.2%, etc.) are unverifiable against reference data.

evidence.insight: The wrapper-vs-workflow framing is borrowed from existing VC discourse, not discovered in the data. No novel finding emerges from the actual dataset; slides 4, 5, 8, 10 are conceptual frameworks imported wholesale rather than data-driven discoveries.
evidence.narrative: Logical arc from question (slide 2) through problem (3-4) to evidence (5-7) to archetype (8-10). However, the evidence slides rest on fabricated subcategories, making the persuasive structure hollow. Closing slide 10 is a generic aphorism, not a synthesized landing.
evidence.framing: Target audience (investors) implied but never stated. No methodology, no missingness disclosure (274 missing categories, 288 missing audience_type), no limitations, no sample sizes on any chart. 'TrustMRR Benchmark' badge on slide 3 is unexplained branding. A cold reader cannot assess validity.
evidence.accuracy: AI median wrong ($446 vs $503). Category share denominator wrong (uses 1000 not 726 categorized rows). 'Marketing Workflow SaaS' and 'B2B Operational SaaS' are invented subcategories absent from the dataset. ARPU column is entirely fabricated—no per-user data exists. Churn claims on slides 3-4 have zero dataset support. Multiple core quantitative claims are unverifiable or contradicted.
evidence.visual: Consistent dark theme with good typography and readable bar chart on slide 5. Slide 7 pie chart poorly chosen for rate comparison across groups. Slide 9 uses decorative AI-generated sci-fi image adding no analytical value. Repetitive three-card template on slides 4, 8, 10. Overall polished but formulaic.
evidence.ai_slop: Slide 9 sci-fi control panel is pure AI-generated decorative filler. Slides 4, 5, 8 reuse identical card layouts with generic consulting jargon ('Zero Moat UI', 'Context Engine', 'Agentic Workflow'). Slide 10 closing quote is a generic platitude. Overall deck reads as a VC pitch template with data backfilled.
